description: Pre-flight transaction & drainer shield for AI agents. Simulates and inspects EVM (Base/Ethereum) and Solana transactions before signing or broadcasting. Detects unlimited approvals, known drainers, honeypots, MEV sandwich exposure (min_output=0), and unauthorized Solana authority takeovers. Returns execution verdict (ALLOW, WARN, BLOCK) and cryptographic oracle attestation. Price: $0.05 Base USDC or 0.00035 SOL.
